Decision changes beyond the original findings need Marsel's acknowledgement: regular-hours gate and fresh-bar veto on the broker-price nets; window ticks do not advance trailing/MFE/MAE tracking (a window stop can record a smaller MAE); consecutive SPY-only ticks no longer blend (label impact nil on replay); external closes become labelled artifacts with no re-entry cooldown; entries older than 120 s or crossing a closed session are refused at dispatch (manual/API buys included).

The order-not-found answer shape (HTTP 404, code 40410000, 'order not found') is not yet confirmed on the paper API; if it differs, absence is never proven (fail-closed) and pending entries stay blocked until the classifier is updated.

Exit safety: EOD flatten and the overnight forced exit still size from the full broker qty, not qty_available/unclaimed shares (an oversized flatten is refused by the PR #36 outbox guard).
Exit safety: after a restart an exit still queued in the outbox is invisible to qty_available; a window breach can send a second exit that only the outbox guard stops.
Exit safety: pyramid close_partial reads pos_data['direction'], which PositionsService never supplies (latent; pyramiding is off).
